DELTA-E2 is version 10 on the held version 9 bytes, sha256 526dfde3aaa26711cc116f160d8af2a3efe4e944a774e94c0be2754b0299a180, 21902372 bytes. No rebuild. The live file was not written. QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor.

PE-REVIEW-G is corrected. The pass line is withdrawn. E2, rpt-sciences-g6-review-e2-admission-limits-1022, is a scoped arithmetic check: stress inverted from the owner's margins, thermal scaled from the owner's baseline, growth and joining unchecked, closure roots not independently optimized, and no direct DOI validation.

069's modulus is 293.6 GPa. The 290 GPa join figure is rejected. 073's equibiaxial result supersedes the claim that 069's float survives. The version-9 card line is superseded by the version-10 card. The old sentence remains only as the amendment's previous text.

Findings stay 2416. Design numbers are unchanged. MAINLINE-074 follows.
